espn-603998.headline: Borthwick has his bosses. Australia want paying.
beats: England's bosses have publicly given Steve Borthwick their full support, which tends to get said only when it needs saying. Australia arrive at Allianz Stadium embroiled in a pay row.

Both sides carry the year with them. England's last two wins, over Fiji and Argentina, followed a 21–45 loss in South Africa and their worst-ever Six Nations. Australia beat South Africa 42–38 in September, then conceded 50 and 43 to New Zealand in October.
Ben Curry starts in place of his injured twin, Tom, with concerns Tom may miss the whole Nations Championship. Fraser McReight wins his 50th cap on the other side.
An Australia win lifts them to 5th in the world and drops England to 7th. England won this fixture 25–7 at home last November. This time Planet Rugby expects them to have "just enough".

espn-603999.headline: France can hand New Zealand what three Tests did not
beats: South Africa beat New Zealand three times at home in late August and September, by 7, 5 and 15 points. Lose by any margin in Saint-Denis and the No. 1 ranking passes to New Zealand anyway.

France hosted South Africa last November too, and lost 17–32. The Springboks' last outing was a 66–7 win over Italy in Turin, 45–0 up just after the half-hour, and Rassie Erasmus still said they were not perfect.

France's one defeat in the Nations Championship came by two points in Christchurch, with a side missing its Montpellier and Toulouse stars. Antoine Dupont and Romain Ntamack were set to start together against Fiji for the first time since March 2025.
Erasmus wants more against France and Ireland. He gets them a week apart, with New Zealand level with him on points.

espn-604000.headline: Italy's five straight losses meet Argentina's near misses
beats: Italy are bottom of the Nations Championship, pointless after four games. Last Saturday South Africa put 66 on them in Turin. Argentina's weekend ended 42–12 away to Ireland.
Argentina lost by seven to England and to South Africa this year, then drew with Australia. They know close games. They just do not win them.
Win in Genova and Italy rise to ninth in the world, one place behind the side they beat.
Fiji, the only other team without a point, visit the week after. Lose here and that becomes the game Italy's year is measured by.

espn-604001.headline: The 1953 wait meets the side that scored 52 here
beats: Wales are eyeing a first win over New Zealand since 1953. Their last attempt, on this ground on 22 November 2025, ended 26–52, so the more modest target is keeping it under fifty.
New Zealand are unbeaten in the Nations Championship after 43–21 at Murrayfield. Ewan Ashman scored a first-half hat-trick for Scotland, and Scotland then failed to score after the break.
Dave Rennie now wins 70% of his Tests, and three of the defeats came in South Africa. Wales went there in July and lost 0–43 without a try.
Win, and Wales climb to ninth, above Fiji. That is a small step in the rankings for ending a wait that long.

espn-604002.headline: The fixture England are meant to win, as Italy was
beats: England lost 18–23 to Italy in March, part of their worst-ever Six Nations. Wins since, 73–8 over Fiji and 31–24 in Argentina, have restored some order but not much certainty.

Japan know the other Fiji. They beat them 20–15 in September, lost to them 28–34 at home a month later, and have slipped from 9th to 12th in the world. They can still score: 63 against the USA, 57 against Canada.
England have shipped 48 to France and 45 to South Africa this year, which is how an upset happens. Lose this one and they drop to 7th in the world, below Scotland and Australia.
New Zealand come to England a week later. It is a poor week to be explaining a defeat to Japan.

espn-604003.headline: Ireland have nothing to win here except the game
beats: Ireland have been 3rd in the world since July. Fiji only reached 9th on 26 October. Even a draw would drop Ireland below France.

Ireland come in off a 42–12 win over Argentina: six tries, three of them for Hugo Keenan. Andy Farrell and Tadhg Beirne still said they could have been more ruthless. Fiji's last two Nations Championship games ended 8–73 to England and 17–33 to Scotland, both at home.
South Africa come to Dublin on 21 November, and Farrell has scope to change his whole team for this one. That is how comfortable a side looks when its worst realistic result is a ranking slip.
Fiji's season more likely turns that same day in Italy, against the one side still level with them on no points. A tidy afternoon in Dublin would be decent preparation.

espn-604004.headline: New Zealand beat both 43–21. Now one passes the other
beats: Scotland and Australia were each beaten 43–21 by New Zealand: Australia at home on 17 October, Scotland at Murrayfield on 7 November. Scotland trailed by three at half-time there and did not score again.

Australia let in 50 and 43 against New Zealand in successive weeks, a fortnight after beating South Africa 42–38. Scotland score freely, seven tries against Argentina, but have conceded 43 twice this year.
An Australia win takes sixth in the world off Scotland, and both sides then face a Nations Championship game on 21 November, Scotland at home to Japan and Australia away to Wales.

Gregor Townsend once spent a summer playing club rugby for Warringah in Sydney, and his Scotland sides have played some of their best rugby against Australia. The count across 35 games still reads 22 wins to 13 for Australia.

espn-604005.headline: England won 33–19 last time. New Zealand moved on
beats: New Zealand's last two results were identical, 43–21 against Australia and then Scotland at Murrayfield, where Scotland scored nothing after the break. Dave Rennie's side are unbeaten in the Nations Championship. England's win on 15 November 2025 came before he took over.
England have not played since beating Argentina 31–24 in July. Their year also includes a defeat by Italy and 45 conceded to South Africa, the side New Zealand sit level with on points at the top.

Rennie now wins 70% of his Tests, and most of the losses came against South Africa, three of them in South Africa. Beat his side by 16 or more and England go up to third in the world, above Ireland and France.
England have nothing scheduled after this, so whatever happens will have to last them a while.

espn-604006.headline: Scotland owe Murrayfield a second half
beats: Scotland were three points behind New Zealand at half-time on 7 November and did not score again. It finished 43–21, with captain Sione Tuipulotu sin-binned on 50 minutes and Ewan Ashman's hat-trick already a first-half memory.
Tuipulotu called it "nowhere near accurate enough". Scotland conceded 13 penalties to eight, and the fix has to come on the same ground.

Japan arrive with their own reversal. They beat Fiji 20–15 in September and lost to them at home, 28–34, in October. That second result helped drop them from 9th to 12th in the world, and a win here would put them straight back to 9th while sending Scotland below Australia.
After this, Scotland's next fixture is Uruguay at the World Cup in October 2027. Plenty of time to think about whichever half they play best.

espn-604007.headline: Ireland's scrum has had a year to think about it
beats: South Africa won 24–13 in Dublin on 22 November 2025, on a day Ireland's scrum came apart. Andrew Porter has not played for Ireland since, and the Leinster loosehead says he is ready to settle the score.

Ireland beat Argentina 42–12 with six tries, three of them to Hugo Keenan, and Andy Farrell still wants them "more ruthless". South Africa put 66 past Italy in Turin, and Rassie Erasmus says they must raise their game for France and Ireland.
South Africa are top of the Nations Championship on points difference alone. Lose here and they also slip to second in the world, behind New Zealand.
Victor Matfield would not be surprised if Erasmus tried uncapped youngsters against France or Ireland. Porter has spent a year waiting for this game, whoever packs down opposite.

espn-604008.headline: Twelfth plays eleventh, and neither has a point
beats: Italy have lost all four Nations Championship games and are 153 points down on the tournament. Fiji have lost three, 96 down. Somebody in Udine finally gets to write something in the other column.
Italy come off five straight defeats, the latest 66–7 to South Africa in Turin. Fiji at least remember how it feels: they beat Japan 34–28 away in October, a month after Japan had beaten them 20–15.
Win, and Italy climb from 11th to ninth in the world, above Fiji. Fiji are ranked higher, but their tournament began with a 73–8 home loss to England.
Neither side plays again until the 2027 World Cup. Italy's next opponent there is South Africa, who leave the winner of this one something to think about.

espn-604009.headline: France scored 42 twice; Argentina just let in 42
beats: Argentina were beaten 42–12 in Dublin on 6 November, six tries to two, after Mateo Carreras had scored first. Their captain, Julián Montoya, went off for a head injury assessment on 28 minutes and never returned.

France's last two Tests, in July, finished 42–26 in Australia and 42–15 in Japan, with six tries each time. Argentina have gone five Tests without a win. The nearest they came was a 28–28 draw with Australia in September.
A France win by 16 or more lifts them to third in the world, above Ireland. Ireland beat this Argentina side by 30.

espn-604010.headline: Italy have lost four from four. Wales could still trail them
beats: Wales beat Italy 31-17 in Cardiff in March. Lose to Australia here by any margin and Wales drop below Italy and Japan in the world rankings, twelfth at best.
Australia are not arriving in comfort. They conceded 50 and 43 to New Zealand in October, a fortnight after beating South Africa 42-38. They went into November in a pay dispute.
Wales have their own scar. South Africa held them scoreless in July, 43-0. Steve Tandy called this November pivotal, with Japan first, then New Zealand, then Australia last.
Australia's next fixture is Hong Kong at the World Cup in October 2027. Wales have nothing else scheduled, so whatever happens here is the number they keep.
